coordinateSource: Three independently read original named lighthouse symbols with official MPA named-light positions, plus three individually read rocky headland checks with OSM point coordinates only. See georef-G16-lighthouse-candidates.json for original lighthouse evidence; none of the nine anonymous Warper points is used.
knownGaps: Six named controls do not meet the required16 whole-map qualified controls. Three fixed original lighthouse towers provide stronger anchors; three rocky cape controls retain chart-generalisation uncertainty. Western/northern Singapore inland surveyed-junction coverage is insufficient.
G16 smallcorrections1954; missing1954–1961 coast change must be handled by separately dated sources. Fort Canning lighthouse replica is not used as an original tower control.
